definitions.gloss: price tag; for-sale sign; sale ticket
definitions.explanation: A tag or sign attached to goods indicating the price or indicating that the item is for sale. Can also refer to a ticket sold for an event or transportation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{売札|うりふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The product has a price tag on it.

examples.japanese: {売札|うりふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I checked the price on the tag before buying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{売札|うりふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{貼|は}られて→貼る：10447_haru⟧、{骨董市|こっとういち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Old furniture with price tags attached was lined up at the antique market.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling) and ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (tag, label, card). A somewhat traditional or literary word. In modern everyday speech, ⟦{値札|ねふだ}→値札：09532_nefuda⟧ (price tag) is more commonly used for the price label on merchandise. {売札|うりふだ} retains a slightly old-fashioned flavor and is more likely to appear in formal or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売札|うりふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to attach a price tag
- {売札|うりふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to stick on a for-sale sign
- {売札|うりふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: the amount on the price tag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値札|ねふだ}→値札：09532_nefuda⟧: price tag — the standard modern term for price labels on goods
- {正札|しょうふだ}: list price tag — the official marked price
- ⟦{荷札|にふだ}→荷札：19865_nifuda⟧: luggage tag, shipping label — a tag for identifying packages or baggage
- ⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧: name tag — a tag showing a person's name
